title: Kate Gosselin Shares Devastating Family News: 'We Are Suffering' - NewsBreak
text:
By Effie Orfanides ,
6 hours ago
Kate Gosselin 's family has suffered a heartbreaking loss.
The mother-of-eight took to TikTok to share that her German Shepherd puppy, Meika, had died. The news comes just seven months after Gosselin lost her dog, Nanuq.
"I have tried to write this a few times over the last few days,” Gosselin, 51, wrote on TikTok on Tuesday, July 28. "It feels too final to put it on paper, so to speak. We lost Meika in the middle of the night on Saturday . She went into respiratory failure and they couldn’t revive her. I have NEVER in my life been so broken, angry or grief stricken."
“We are suffering. Koda is suffering," she said, referring to her other dog. "Please give us time to grieve and we’ll be back at some point. Our baby, the closest thing to a child that Steve and I will ever have, was only 15 months and 10 days old," she continued, referring to her boyfriend , Steve Neild. "Life is so cruel and unfair. This one I’ll never heal from," she concluded.
@kate.gosselin She was so young, so perfect in every way, and so healthy. One wrong step and she’s gone. Meeks, I hope Nuq found you and is taking good care of you. You were just a baby, still on puppy food. WHYYYY??? WHY DID THIS HAVE TO HAPPEN TO YOU??!! I know you fought as hard as you could. I hope there’s an endless supply of your favorite balls in heaven and more watermelon than you could ever dream of. We love you, our baby girl, no one will ever come close to you. My tears for you will never stop. Sleep well, our baby. ❤️💔❤️
♬ Quiet Hourglass - Silt the Cat Gosselin received love and support from her fans, many of whom commented on her post with condolences.
"I am so sorry for your loss. It is difficult enough to say goodbye when they are older, but when they are so young it is truly hard to accept," one person wrote.
"You love your dogs so hard (as I do mine). I am truly so sorry for you, Steve, and Koda. What great love Meika had while she was here! From a true dog lover and shepherd owner whose heart is so broken for you," another fan added.
Days prior, Gosselin asked fans for prayers as she shared that she was taking Meika to the emergency vet for the "second time in 12 hours." An X-ray showed that the pup had pneumonia.
@kate.gosselin Reposting in honor of her ‘Gotcha Day’ #puppylove #workinglinegsd #Meika
♬ original sound - kate.gosselin Gosselin often shared pictures and videos of Meika on social media. She introduced Meika to the world in July 2025.
